rawMessage: Rule 81016813: DL380a Gen12 uses dedicated captive GPU risers (P74685-B21). Standard DL380 Gen12 2U risers (P74571-B21, P74573-B21, P74575-B21) are strictly incompatible.
ruleUpdate: On DL380a Gen12, replace standard risers P74571-B21/P74573-B21 with captive GPU riser P74685-B21.

rawMessage: Rule 81016845: NVIDIA double-wide GPUs require either P75002-B21 (4 Double-Wide FIO GPU Kit) or P75008-B21 (8 Double-Wide FIO GPU Kit) for mechanical alignment and PCIe bifurcation.
ruleUpdate: Double-wide GPUs on DL380a mandate P75002-B21 (4DW) or P75008-B21 (8DW) GPU enablement kit.

rawMessage: Rule 81016788: 4SFF drive cage (P74710-B21) and 4EDSFF drive cage (P74712-B21) cannot be populated simultaneously in DL380a front storage bay.
ruleUpdate: DL380a prohibits mixing 4SFF cage P74710-B21 and 4EDSFF cage P74712-B21.

rawMessage: Rule 81017083: Configurations with 4 to 8 double-wide GPUs mandate a minimum of 5x (and up to 6x) 2400W Flex Slot Titanium Hot Plug Power Supplies (P67252-B21). Lower wattage or Platinum PSUs are blocked.
ruleUpdate: DL380a Gen12 with double-wide GPUs mandates minimum 5x 2400W Titanium PSUs (P67252-B21).

rawMessage: Rule 81016855: High-density PCIe Gen5 GPUs mandate 16-pin auxiliary power delivery cables P83526-B21 connecting directly to GPU power distribution bus.
ruleUpdate: 8DW GPU kit requires dedicated 16-pin GPU auxiliary power cables P83526-B21.

rawMessage: Rule 81017767: Compute Ops Management SaaS license (R7A11AAE) satisfies remote server management. Remove unneeded BD505A (iLO Advanced) license to prevent unnecessary customer cost of $469.
ruleUpdate: When R7A11AAE is selected on Gen12, remove redundant iLO Advanced license BD505A.
